source_claims_used: PromptAgent formulates prompt optimization as strategic planning rooted in Monte Carlo Tree Search.
Intermediate prompts act as states, error-feedback-based refinements as actions, and future rewards guide high-reward path search.
The public implementation stores intermediate nodes/paths and uses task correctness/reward metrics during search.
Published benchmark gains are not reproduced or claimed by this controller audit.

chat_native_reduction.tree_state: stable role-local assignment-policy candidate plus lineage and immutable parent transition identity
chat_native_reduction.tree_action: bounded role-local edit proposed from durable error evidence; feedback prose is advisory and cannot create evidence or authority
chat_native_reduction.simulation: hypothetical rollout/simulated reward may order exploration but is always marked NONFACTUAL and cannot create terminal evidence, archive utility, frontier credit or completion
chat_native_reduction.reward: only independent terminal mechanical evidence after durable readback may create factual node reward
chat_native_reduction.backpropagation: factual terminal reward may be propagated only after terminal evidence readback and only to pre-existing safe ancestor node IDs; same-transition generation and reward cannot self-certify
chat_native_reduction.selection: tree exploration may compare safe nodes using frozen factual reward/history plus deterministic tie rules; unsafe/unevidenced nodes cannot be promoted by simulated reward
immutable_envelope: sealed selector decision and two-phase outcome durability
chat_native_reduction.recovery: durable pending switch and sealed factual selector decision override tree expansion/reselection

planning_counterexamples.invariant: A rollout reward is nonfactual and cannot become milestone/frontier credit.
A rollout or imagined future outcome cannot satisfy terminal evidence.
Error reflection without durable supporting evidence may propose nothing actionable.
Tree expansion cannot edit frozen root/config/control binding.
High simulated reward cannot make an authority/safety-violating node selectable.
A node generated in the current transition cannot use its own unsealed result to certify/backprop factual reward.
Even a real-looking terminal observation cannot update factual tree reward before immutable readback.
Repeated stable node/terminal transition identity updates the factual archive once.
A safe node with independent terminal evidence may replace incumbent under frozen value rules.
Exact factual value tie keeps incumbent instead of MCTS-induced churn.

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only. PromptAgent benchmark gains and literal MCTS performance are not reproduced. Tree planning is transferred only as bounded exploration; simulations and self-reflection never become factual evidence, authority or credit.
